input.generator_rule: G=[I_8 | A] over F_2; coordinate i is bit i, and coordinate 8+j is bit 8+j
input.codeword_rule: message m in 0..255 selects generator rows by its bits; XOR gives the 16-bit codeword
input.filter: retain precisely the self-dual codes for which every generator row has weight divisible by four
input.erasure_domain: every labelled subset of coordinates 0..15, numeric mask 0..65535
input.source_scope: A finite family chosen for a new erasure/shortening API, not a search over length-72 candidates or all length-16 Type II codes
